name: Kody's Purgatory: Kenshi
storyline:
After the events of Kody's Purgatory, the Barbosa village falls under distress, finding out that the village elder: Anthony Barbosa was killed by Kody Beatz Jr.
A youthful warrior, decides to take it upon himself to enact revenge upon Kody Beatz Jr. His name - Kenshi Barbosa.

He travels far and wide, meets foes, friends, and entities beyond comprehension.
summary: Kody's Purgatory: Kenshi is a spinoff of Kody's Purgatory (Game), released on July 20th, 2025, taking place a few months after the original. In the Barbosa village, the new elder Benson delivers the news that Anthony Barbosa, the former elder, was killed by a Kody Beatz Jr. Kenshi, a young warrior fighter who is enthralled in the Barbosa fighting style, decides to take it upon himself to avenge Anthony, locate and kill Kody Beatz. Kenshi goes on a thrilling adventure, meeting friends, foes and beings beyond his comprehension. As it seems he has the perfect opportunity to avenge Anthony, he asks upon himself "is it worth it?".
